dedupe_keys.name: global river mouth salinity gradient energy potential and design parameters

description: The Global Salinity Gradient Energy Potential Database estimates blue-energy potential at river mouths by combining river discharge with satellite-derived sea-surface salinity and temperature. The article distinguishes a 10,848-river multiannual discharge collection from a curated 1,078-river collection with monthly variability. The Mendeley version 2 inventory contains two Excel databases and an optional 1.1-gigabyte Windows viewer executable, all under CC BY 4.0. The tables include theoretical and extractable potential and design parameters; they do not represent installed osmotic power plants or measured generation. Discharge source differences, satellite resolution and assumptions in converting salinity gradients into extractable power are limitations for project-level design. A reviewer-assessed use is screening river-mouth energy resources or testing alternative generation siting in electricity planning. model-pypsa is a related power-system model, but no direct input mapping or site feasibility check was performed. The executable and spreadsheets were not downloaded or run.
